rationale: Trained on GAN + PixelDiffusion + LatDiff and evaluated against Midjourney, an entirely unseen generator family: ROC-AUC 0.9832, balanced accuracy 0.9311, FPR 0.1109, FNR 0.0269.

not_used.why_not: That 0.9984 was a WITHIN-family result on a corpus that is 99.3% LatDiff. The same model scored 0.3954 ROC-AUC (below chance) on external cross-family transfer and classified 89.7% of genuine photographs as synthetic. Serving it would misrepresent the detector by roughly 0.6 AUC.

this_is_not_a_production_declaration: RESEARCH_IMAGE_MODEL.json is deliberately named differently from the URL stack's ACTIVE_MODEL.json. There is no production image model. Promotion is blocked on worst-family generalization (GAN balanced accuracy 0.5512, near chance).
url_stack_note: This file governs IMAGES ONLY. models/ACTIVE_MODEL.json continues to serve basirah-url-v3 and is unaffected.
